content: Next.js v15 docs list Node.js 18.18+ and describe TypeScript/App Router setup; the v15 upgrade guide sets React and React DOM minimum to 19 and flags asynchronous request APIs. Current v15 registry metadata checked at 15.5.28; it peers with React 19. Tailwind v4 and current shadcn Next installation guidance use the standard App Router setup. Use Node 22.12+ for overlap with current test/database toolchains.
